Kuala Lumpur Islamic Finance & Halal Economy Summit 2026 (KLIFHES 2026) | Peatix
KLIFHES 2026 — Kuala Lumpur Islamic Finance & Halal Economy Summit
Wed, 9 Dec 2026 – Thu, 10 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (GMT+08:00)
Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, Jalan Pinang, 50088 Kuala Lumpur
Follow · Organised by Malaysian Islamic Finance Professionals Association
Join industry leaders, Shariah scholars and regulators for two days of keynotes, panel discussions and
workshops on sukuk, takaful, zakat, waqf and the global halal economy.
Featured speakers
- Dr. Aisha Rahman Malik, Member, Shariah Advisory Panel
- Encik Hafiz Zulkifli, Chief Executive Officer, Halal Industry Development Office
- Prof. Dr. Ahmad Kamil Yusof, Kulliyyah of Economics, IIUM
Tickets
Early Bird (until 30 Nov 2026): RM150
Standard: RM250
Student (with valid ID): RM80
Ticket price includes lunch, tea breaks and conference kit.
Side events
Pre-Summit Workshop: Zakat & Waqf Fintech — Tue, 8 Dec 2026, 2:00 PM – 5:30 PM, Seminar Room 3, Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre. RM 99 (limited to 40 participants)
Halal Economy Networking Dinner — Wed, 9 Dec 2026, 8:00 PM, Grand Ballroom, Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre. RM 120 per pax
